products.name: Ivory Bloom Abaya
products.tagline: Ivory in bloom, light as air.
products.description: Hand-finished floral print scattered across ivory crepe — soft balloon sleeves tied with little bows at the cuff, falling from a gathered yoke into one full-flowing skirt. Light, breezy and completely non-sheer: modesty with a garden in its step.

products.name: Noir Flow Abaya
products.tagline: The signature sweep — one unbroken line.
products.description: Our signature abaya — a generous sweep of premium Nida that falls away from the body in one unbroken line, styled with a soft ash-grey scarf to finish the look. Wide cuffs, full coverage, completely non-sheer. Cut loose on purpose: modesty that never asks for adjusting.

products.name: Sage Layers Abaya
products.tagline: Sage calm, cut long and loose.
products.description: Sage-green crinkle fabric cut long and loose, layered under a matching shoulder cape and finished with a soft ivory scarf. Weightless linen-touch weave, full coverage, completely non-sheer — everyday calm, tailored wide.

products.name: Mocha Crepe Abaya
products.description: Warm chocolate crepe with a sculpted, enveloping cut and a delicate chain-belt detail at the waist. It falls in one clean sweep to the floor — full coverage, completely non-sheer, quietly rich.

products.name: Bordeaux Layers Abaya
products.description: A layered occasion piece in deep bordeaux — an overlapping cape panel spills across the shoulders over a full, gathered skirt, finished with a sand-toned scarf. Rich, flowing and completely non-sheer: the abaya that walks into the room before you do.

products.name: Charcoal Mist Abaya
products.tagline: Wrapped in mist, matte and poised.
products.description: Deep charcoal with a quiet matte finish and an asymmetric drape that wraps the shoulders like mist. Weighty crepe holds its line all day — full coverage, completely non-sheer, made to move with you, never against you.

products.name: Rose Taupe Abaya
products.description: Dusty rose softened towards taupe — a gentle, earthy pink that flatters every skin tone. Delicate pearl buttons line the cuffs; the body stays loose, flowing and fully covered. The piece people ask you about.

products.name: Onyx Luxe Abaya
products.tagline: The occasion piece — gold thread, satin soul.
products.description: The atelier at its most considered: lustrous black satin-finish fabric, hand-guided gold threadwork at the cuffs, and a silhouette that falls like poured ink. Loose, covering and unmistakably occasion. Limited batch.
